shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && ls -R .agents/skills/gravity-ui | head -50 && echo "-----" && cat AGENTS.md && echo "-----" && cat package.json && ls

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "----- TABLE entries" && rg -n -i -C 3 "table" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80 && echo "----- SRC" && find src -type f | head -50 && echo && cat src/*.tsx 2>/dev/null | head -120 && echo "----- index.html / tsconfig / vite" && cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && echo "----- eval" && ls -R __agent_eval__ | head -30 && echo "----- installed gravity" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | rg -n '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -60; echo "----- TRAPS"; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -60; echo "----- DTS"; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $U/Table/Table.d.ts; echo; cat $U/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts; echo; cat $U/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; echo; cat $U/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts; echo; cat $U/Pagination/types.d.ts; echo "----- README Table"; ls $U/Table/ ; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -name "README.md" -path "*Table*" | head; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -name "README.md" -path "*Pagination*" | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo "----- sorting js meta keys"; rg -n "meta|getRowId|disableDataSorting|sortState" $U/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -40; echo "----- selection js"; rg -n "getRowId|getRowDescriptor|disabled|Checkbox" $U/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -30; echo "----- index exports"; cat $U/Table/index.d.ts; echo "----- ONLINE"; curl -sS -m 20 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/uikit7.txt; echo "exit=$? size=$(wc -c < /tmp/uikit7.txt 2>/dev/null)"; head -c 300 /tmp/uikit7.txt; echo; rg -n -i "withTableSorting|defaultSortOrder|meta.*sort" /tmp/uikit7.txt | head -30

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; rg -n -A8 "static getRowId" $U/Table/Table.js | head -20; echo "----- Label themes"; rg -n "theme\?|LabelTheme|size\?" $U/Label/Label.d.ts | head; echo "----- Text variants"; rg -n "caption|body-|subheader" $U/Text/text/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5 || rg -n "TEXT_VARIANTS|caption-2" $U/Text -l | head
